questions: Should the random integers be generated from the inclusive range [low, high) (i.e., high is exclusive) or [low, high] (inclusive)?
Is the shape parameter required to be a tuple of two positive integers, or can it be any shape (e.g., 1D, 3D, or non-integer)?
If the matrix has only one element (e.g., shape (1,1)), are there any pairs? Should the sum of products be 0, or should the function handle this case differently?
Does the seed parameter control only the matrix generation, or should it also affect any other randomness (e.g., order of pairs)?
Should the function accept negative values for low and high, and if so, does the product sum calculation handle them correctly?
Is the output order guaranteed to be (sum_of_products, matrix) as shown, or could it be (matrix, sum_of_products)?
Should the function raise an error if shape contains non-integer values or zeros (e.g., (0,5))?
Are floating-point numbers allowed for low and high, or are they restricted to integers?
